tables.name: EVENTS
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "EVENTS" (
"ocel:eid" TEXT,
  "ocel:timestamp" TIMESTAMP,
  "ocel:activity" TEXT,
  "cost" REAL,
  "count" REAL,
  "rush" INTEGER,
  "slot" TIMESTAMP,
  "note" TEXT
)

tables.name: RELATIONS

  "ocel:timestamp" TIMESTAMP,
  "ocel:oid" TEXT,
  "ocel:type" TEXT,
  "ocel:qualifier" TEXT
)

tables.name: OBJECTS

CREATE TABLE "OBJECTS" (

  "label" REAL,
  "weight" REAL
